QuestInfo.name: Mai's Second Training
QuestInfo.1: After you finished hunting Stumps, Mai thought you had some talent and turned the training up a notch. This time, you must hunt #r5 Red Snails#k. They are faster than Stumps, so watch out. \n\nRed Snail #r#a10421##k
QuestInfo.2: Red Snails have much higher endurance than Snails and Blue Snails. They also move faster than Stumps. You better not underestimate those sneaky creatures.

0.0: Whoa, that was fast! You've got a talent for hunting... Impressive! Okay, moving on. This time, hunt #r5 Red Snails#k.

yes.0: Red Snails have more HP than Snails and Blue Snails. They are also faster than Stumps, so don't underestimate them.

no.0: Five Red Snails too much for you? I'm telling you, enduring hardships like will help you progress!

mob.0: You haven't hunted #r5 Red Snails#k yet. If it's too hard, just take your time!
